what: Coeur Mining digs silver and gold out of five mines in the United States, Mexico and Canada, including the Rochester silver mine in Nevada and the Las Chispas mine acquired in 2025.
customers: Refiners and metal traders; silver and gold sell at world prices.
money: output from Palmarejo, Kensington and Wharf
moat: Mines already permitted and built, in an industry where a new mine takes a decade and a billion dollars, and where primary silver deposits are genuinely rare.
risks: Earnings move entirely with silver and gold prices, which the company does not control
The Rochester expansion ran over budget and took years longer than planned
Mines in Mexico carry permitting and security risk
opportunities: 13.4 times earnings with a 28.3% net margin and $1.2B of free cash flow
Revenue nearly tripled from $786M to $2.1B in three years as Rochester ramped and metal prices rose
Analysts see about 85% upside, with 11 covering the stock, and debt is almost cleared at $35M
watch: All-in sustaining cost per ounce and Rochester's throughput.
